description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ihalagama, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511839 (23/0022)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel No. 51 and 230) with detailed land ownership information, including owner names, property details, extent, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
